items.headline: Gant runs for 151 yards, Stire delivers winning kick as Akron edges UMass 34-33
items.description: — Jordan Gant ran for 151 yards with two touchdowns, Aidan Stire kicked the go-ahead field goal in the fourth quarter, and Akron edged Massachusetts 34-33 on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Bottom 10 after Week 11: Paying tribute to our founding father
items.description: The originator of celebrating football's downtrodden, former Los Angeles columnist Steve Harvey, died last week.

items.headline: Take a 360-degree look at college football's iconic rivalry trophies
items.description: Whether ancient, animal or absurd, college football's rivalry trophies take many shapes.

items.headline: UMass and Akron meet in MAC action
items.description: Akron (1-9) at UMass (5-5), Nov. 18 at 7 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Bottom 10 after Week 10: Toothless Wolverines on list after rivalry loss
items.description: In a season where several big-name programs are struggling, Michigan is the latest to lay an egg.

items.headline: Buckley, Cabana power rushing attack for Western Michigan in 42-14 win over Akron
items.description: — Jalen Buckley dashed for 121 yards and two touchdowns, Cole Cabana added 107 rushing yards and a score, and Western Michigan defeated Akron 42-14 on Tuesday night.
